note: Empty until a native reviewer fills it; the lessons keep the Azerbaijani world meanwhile. Fill, as in de.json: market (ISO country), people (female, male and family names; gendered where the language needs it), cities, districts, currency (code, and the symbol that replaces AZN), amounts (typical salary, invoice, fine and gift card in that currency), phone (code and the mobile and landline patterns, # = a digit), iban (pattern), government (tax, police, courts, social insurance), brands (every key of az-world.json brands: local name, fictional domain, short description), phrases (inflected authority names, currency words, the country, emergency numbers, words in file and network names), elisions, honorifics (titles before which a given name becomes a family name) and addresses (every word of az-world.json addressWords in its local form inside addresses; brand slugs follow the brands' domains). Then set status to ready and run npx tsx scripts/apply-market.ts ru.
